messages.subject: ggmap: Plot within a plot
parts:
Hello fellow ggplotters,

I am attempting to create a ggmap plot within a ggmap plot and some on
the finer point of the process are eluding me. The example will
illustrate where I am so far. First, I want to draw an open square on
the mainplot that corresponds to the position of the bounding box of
the subplot. As you can see I have right now manually used a open
square point but this isn't a perfect situation as in subsequent
similar plots I will have to manually place the same point. Can anyone
recommend a way to a) access the coordinates of bounding box in the
subplot and b) plot a square using those coordinates on the mainplot?

In another, not too different matter, I'd like to place a border
around the subplot to better distinguish it on the map. Any
suggestions there?

I really like the develop with ggmap and a big thanks to David Kahle
for all his hard work here.

Thanks in advance!

Sam

Code:

library(ggplot2)
library(ggmap)
library(grid)

###
# Functions
###
full <- function() {
print(mainplot)
print(subplot, vp = vp)
}


## Get the maps
map <- get_map(maptype = 'sat', location = c(lon=-121.1356,
lat=52.40725), filename = "big",zoom=10)
lil_map <- get_map(maptype = 'sat', location = c(lon=-121.3817,
lat=52.4708), filename = "lil", zoom=15)


## Set the boundaries
vp <- viewport(width = 0.3, height = 0.3,
x = 0.97,
y = 0.66,
just = c("right","bottom"))

## Make the plots

mainplot <- ggmap(map) +
labs(x="Longitude",y="Latitude") +
geom_point(x=-121.3617, y=52.4808, pch=0, size=6,col='white')

subplot <- ggmap(lil_map, extent='device')


## Generate the plots
full()
